text:
Mia: heads up — onboarding SplineNet-v2 (converted from Mistral) on q4_n. short prompts match fp16 but with long prompts (>>512) the summaries drift left.
Arjun: can you repro deterministically on fp16 vs q4_n? rule out conversion vs quant.
Mia: yes repro attached. fp16 stable; q4_n diverges after ~600 tokens. per-token KL grows.
Lucy: first thought: rotary / positional scale mismatch during conversion. some exporters serialize multipliers weirdly.
Mia: diff snippet: `max_diff=0.0132 layer=10 attn_out` and final logits show subtle shift toward earlier tokens.
Sam: tokenizer remap? nfkc or different sentinel indices can surface as off-by-one output shifts.
Mia: compared vocab.json pre/post-conversion — token ids line up. found exported config has "rotary_scale":"sqrt(0.5)" (string) while original has numeric 0.70710678.
Lucy: if our loader expects a float and gets a string it may fallback to 1.0. that would change phase warp and break long context.
Arjun: confirm by forcing numeric rotary_scale in converted config and re-export q4_n.
Mia: did that locally — re-export w numeric rotary_scale -> longctx max_diff down from 0.0132 to 0.0027.
ModelBot: quick-bench: patched-rotary q4_n vs fp16: latency +9%, tokens/s similar, summarization ROUGE +/-0.1.
Sam: residual tail skew could be quant scattering around softmax logits. what quant kernel? bitsandbytes or custom?
Mia: our runtime custom int4. suspect accumulation precision in final linear before softmax.
Lucy: test: run last linear in fp16 (partial dequant) and keep rest int4.
Mia: partial-dequant of pre-softmax to fp16 => max_diff 0.0009. so quant noise concentrated in logit head matmul.
Sam: interim mitigation: export flag `--logit-fp16` to keep logit head in fp16 for longctx-sensitive models.
Arjun: also add a converter check to fail if rotary_scale is non-numeric (and print original token of config).
Mia: will add both patches and schedule regression suite (summarize / qa / ppl).
Lucy: add per-head attention correlation check too — head permutation or headmask reorder can leave subtle residuals.
Mia: adding plots and CI unit that compares attention maps headwise and raises if corr < 0.98.
Sam: tiny doc update requested: add "rotary_scale string vs numeric" to onboarding checklist.
Mia: will PR to docs/convert-checklist.md after canary results.
ModelBot: regression job queued: job/79321 — will post results when complete.
Mia: thanks team :thumbsup: will post canary link when ready.
